scope: Common domain, inverse law and Hilbert extension of the normalized simple-root operators for the spherical minimal principal series at regular imaginary split charge.

common_domain.rank_one_restriction: each simple-root string is the even Fourier core from K1331
common_domain.smooth_extension: rapid K-type decay and moderate meromorphic eigenvalue growth extend the family to C-infinity(K/M)

regular_imaginary_axis.mode_modulus: |a_n(i t)|=1 for every n in Z
regular_imaginary_axis.hilbert_extension: unique bounded unitary operator H_lambda -> H_(s_alpha lambda)
regular_imaginary_axis.zero_parameter: R_0=I on the spherical even principal series
regular_imaginary_axis.regular_charge_consequence: all 42 root coordinates are nonzero imaginary and every simple operator is bounded, unitary and invertible

theorem_context.reference: A.W. Knapp and E.M. Stein, Singular Integrals and the Principal Series IV, Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. USA 72 (1975), 2459-2461
theorem_context.used_result: normalized cocycle, adjoint and unitarity on imaginary parameters

claim_ceiling: The mathematical spherical principal-series operators share the dense K-finite core and extend unitarily on regular imaginary charge. This is not a common closed domain for the interacting GU BV-BFV operators.
